title: Digital Lab: Build an AI app with Azure SQL Hyperscale, Microsoft Fabric, & Foundry
description:
Build an AI-powered FAQ assistant using Azure SQL Database vector search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Azure OpenAI Service. Use GitHub Copilot to speed T-SQL, mirror data into Microsoft Fabric (OneLake) for analytics, apply governance with Microsoft Purview, and orchestrate the workflow with Microsoft Foundry Agents.

This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab, and then after authentication, follow the instructions listed on the lab page to complete the activity. For technical issues or support, please contact the support team via this link: https://skill.info/build26labsupport.
